comparison.objective: Weigh a block and reject it if heavy, versus commission a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Place on scale, interpret weight, and divert the block versus hex-key insertion, collar rotation, counterholding, locking, and impact-response observation.
comparison.success_condition: Correct heavy-block rejection is title-implied; no body/specs or mass threshold is supplied. Candidate uses energy, velocity, stroke, rebound, hard-stop, and drift criteria.
comparison.reason: Measurement-based sorting does not test mechanical adjustment or dynamic stopping performance.
